initial_stage_regression_on_rc29.scope: Initial 23 cases: ten missing-text failures and three already-correct 96-glyph cases missing the new row-path evidence; not all 38 new tests.

punctuation_regression_before_fix.scope: Ten later pure-punctuation cases; four missing-text failures before the punctuation fix.

matching_face_pdf.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc29 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

all_ten_saved_dxf.method: Fresh recognition of the same 84 saved DXFs with all ten verified unchanged r2 catalogs cached. Source geometry compared in every case; unchanged text cases compare every other recognition field and entitydb tag except writer time. Enclosure diagnostics/proof fields intentionally change. Not 84 PDF conversions.

changed_case_independent_audit.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc29 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

existing_long_pdf.method: Four real open fonts; 97/193-character 20pt stroke and filled-Bezier PDFs with original advances. Normal Converter resource loading. Same original PDF bytes as rc29; compare saved rc29 source entity tags and text. Converter sampling and r2 catalogs are unchanged; the current local row evidence pipeline is exercised. Every glyph is checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen at its PDF position, with complete source handles/digests and saved TEXT insertion/alignment endpoints. Font files are used only to generate/audit fixtures, never by runtime recognition.
